coverage_claim: WM-ECO-024 covers one governed fulfilment aggregate from external obligation and promised subject through composition, allocation, readiness, dispatch or activation, handover, receipt, inspection, exceptions, reconciliation, completion, governance and loss-aware projections. Candidate relations, sector and jurisdiction profiles, legal determinations and independent external review remain deferred.

boundary_decision.rationale: The root is an obligation-performance and evidence aggregate. Order, party, product, inventory, shipment, consignment, package, service execution, entitlement, invoice, payment, return, refund and records remain external masters.

decisions.rationale: The fulfilment case binds an external obligation to versioned performance evidence without becoming the order, inventory, shipment, service, invoice or payment master.
The candidate ledger says Purchase Order contains fulfilment obligations. This is retained as a non-canonical parent reference and grants no cascade mutation authority.
Shipment and Invoice are plausible external evidence neighbors, but the candidate edges do not let fulfilment own their state, execution or disposition.

decisions.concept: Promised subjects, units, quantities and conditions
decisions.rationale: Products, services, resources, content, lots and serials remain external while fulfilment units, splits, quantities, substitution, tolerance and condition are source-qualified bindings.
Planning and readiness assertions are local context; inventory movement, warehouse execution, service provisioning and carrier operations remain external.
Each step preserves independent actor, source, evidence, state and time; a delivery claim cannot prove intended-recipient receipt, inspection or acceptance.
Shortage, excess, damage, loss, delay, failure, retry, replacement, rejection, completion and discharge remain separately attributable; return and compensation execute elsewhere.
CISG and EU consumer and sales rules are scoped profiles rather than universal definitions of delivery, risk transfer, conformity or remedies.
UBL, UN/EDIFACT, EPCIS, Schema.org, TM Forum, RFC, PROV, DQV, ODRL and OpenAPI cover different facets and never replace the canonical aggregate.

One bounded Claude Sonnet and one bounded Grok attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex separately audited the frozen validated result and comparison without new facts; assurance remains reviewable-draft.

publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-ECO-024 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.
Relation hold: WM-ECO-019 CONTAINS WM-ECO-024 and WM-ECO-024 references to WM-FLW-011 and WM-ECO-008 remain candidate ledger edges, not canonical relations.
Boundary hold: fulfilment, order, party, product, inventory, shipment, consignment, package, service execution, entitlement, invoice, payment, return, refund and records retain separate identities.
State-axis hold: commitment, allocation, readiness, dispatch, custody, attempt, handover, receipt, inspection, acceptance, completion, billing and payment states and clocks must not collapse.
Quantity and condition hold: every promised, allocated, dispatched, received, accepted, rejected and outstanding value requires item, unit, lot or serial, method, source, time and uncertainty.
Temporal hold: requested, promised, planned, ready, dispatched, arrived, attempted, handed-over, received, inspected, accepted, completed, observed, ingested and known times remain distinct.
Completion hold: delivered, received, accepted, completed, conforming, paid, discharged and dispute-free require separate evidence and authority.

Authority hold: order acceptance, allocation, dispatch, activation, receipt signature, conformity acceptance, discharge, billing, payment, return, refund, disclosure and disposition require delegated authority.
Jurisdiction hold: CISG and EU consumer and sale-of-goods rules are scoped profiles; national, sector, safety, customs and contract rules need validation.
Interoperability hold: every UBL, UN/EDIFACT, EPCIS, Schema.org, TM Forum, RFC, PROV, DQV, ODRL and OpenAPI projection needs version pins, conformance evidence and loss declarations.
Privacy hold: recipient, address, route, access-code, item, serial, condition, tracking, proof and dispute data require purpose-bound access, minimization and retention controls.
deferred_research: Canonically adjudicate the WM-ECO-019 containment and WM-FLW-011 and WM-ECO-008 reference edges and register remaining neighbor relations.
Create goods, services, digital delivery, utilities, healthcare, food, hazardous-material, installation and regulated-sector profiles.
Conformance-test dispatch, receipt, inspection, quantity, condition, exception, completion and projection mappings against concrete implementations.
Validate organization-specific allocation, substitution, delivery, acceptance, safety, privacy, retention and emergency-access policies.
Obtain authorized legal, consumer, logistics, safety, customs and financial review before jurisdiction-specific claims.
Obtain independent external research review before promotion beyond reviewable-draft assurance.
